function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

**Next Major Festival in the United States (as of September 3, 2026)** | Festival | Dates | Location | What to Expect | Ticket Info | |----------|-------|----------|----------------|-------------| | **Sundance Film Festival** | **January 19 – 29, 2027** | Park City, Utah (main venue: Sundance Resort & Snowmass) | • Premieres of independent films (feature‑length, shorts, documentaries)
• Panels, Q&A sessions with filmmakers
• Industry networking events (Sundance NEXT, Sundance Institute labs)
• Live music, art installations, and a “Sundance Film Festival Gala” | • Early‑bird tickets start at $25 (for the first 2 days)
• Full‑festival passes range from $200–$400 depending on seating
• Tickets available through the official Sundance website (www.sundance.org) | ### Why Sundance? - **Industry Hub:** It’s the premier gathering for indie filmmakers, distributors, and critics. - **Cultural Impact:** Many films that premiere here go on to win Oscars or become cult classics. - **Community Experience:** The town of Park City turns into a vibrant arts hub with food trucks, pop‑up galleries, and live performances. ### Quick Tips for Attending 1. **Book Early:** Tickets sell out fast—especially for the opening and closing nights. 2. **Plan Your Schedule:** Use the Sundance app or website to map out screenings, panels, and networking events. 3. **Stay Overnight:** Accommodation in Park City can be pricey; consider staying in nearby towns (e.g., Heber, Midway) and commuting. 4. **Explore the Town:** Beyond the festival, Park City offers ski resorts, hiking trails, and a historic Main Street with shops and restaurants. --- #### Other Notable Upcoming Festivals (in case you’re looking for something else) | Festival | Dates | Location | Highlights | |----------|-------|----------|------------| | **SXSW (South by Southwest)** | March 11 – 20, 2027 | Austin, Texas | Music, film, interactive media, tech talks | | **New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival** | April 27 – May 1, 2027 | New Orleans, Louisiana | Jazz, blues, Cajun, Creole music, food | | **Burning Man** | August 28 – September 5, 2027 | Black Rock Desert, Nevada | Art installations, community-driven culture, “Leave No Trace” ethos | Feel free to let me know if you’d like more details on any of these events, or if you’re interested in a specific type of festival (music, food, tech, etc.).
